t.why: The United States and most EU countries recognize it, but Serbia, Russia and China do not. NATO peacekeepers are stationed there.
t.rel: It declared independence from Serbia in 2008. The United States and most EU countries recognize it, but Serbia, Russia, China and others do not, and it is negotiating normalization with Serbia through EU mediation.
t.korea: Korea recognized it as a state in 2008.
t.know: Kosovo's flag shows a map of the country; only Cyprus and Kosovo have such flags.
t.etext: Diaspora remittances and services hold up the economy. It uses the euro and has metal ores. Incomes are on the low side for Europe.
